usage: Usually means care, maintenance, or upkeep. For jewellery, it often means keeping the item in good condition.
Common in shop/service talk: people may ask about 保養 for cleaning, checking, repair, or warranty-like maintenance.
Can be used as a noun after verbs like 做, 送, or 提供 to talk about maintenance service.
In everyday speech, it is more about proper care than daily use; for long-lasting items like jewellery, watches, or appliances, it is a very natural word.
